summary: HWH International Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a $10M PIPE with Smart Dynamics Technology Ltd for 20M shares and warrants for up to 160M shares at $0.63; also a $500k stock sale to majority shareholder Alset Inc. at $2.00/share. The PIPE adds a Nasdaq compliance extension condition. Board/advisor not named. The warrant overhang is massive. Risk-arb: watch shareholder approval and Nasdaq listing compliance.
